title: Project Perfection
description: The Official Modpack of The Project Perfection SMP
body:
![The title of the modpack, with a Gradient Background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/659cea80e9a538f732db45493714306b9f02972c.png)

Project Perfection is a modpack for a private SMP between friends.

The modpack includes mods/resource packs such as;
---------------------------------------------------
-A Custom Made Resource Pack to Change the Minecraft Title to the "Project Perfection" Logo

-Backpacks/ Lootr, to Help Encourage Exploration

-Dungeons & Taverns, for More Variaty in Structures

-Banner Flags/Bed Sheets, to Add More Customisation for Bases

-Controlify, to Add Controller Support

And More!

Other Features/Notes
----------------------
-This Pack has been tested to be compatible with Steam Decks.

-Updates to the Pack are expected, but not planned
----------------------------------------------------

I hope You Enjoy Playing!
-P.C
